fields.v: Partly (0.5): the authors' SKILL-generation pipeline (reverse-PR mining at a frozen base + paired objective driving GEPA/SkillOpt) states its requirements: Claude Code + Sonnet 4.6, per-repo Docker image, about $0.84 per rollout, $182-485 and 4.7-25.2 h per optimization run, at least 100 graded tasks; two of five repositories (tracy, http4k) could not supply them
fields.quote: Concretely, we treat SKILL generation as an optimization of a single .md document against a metric mined from the target repository itself.
fields.why: The paper presents its own pipeline for generating SKILLs (verifier plus proposer), which can be read as proposing an approach, making Q13 applicable instead of N/A.
fields.doubt: Os autores apresentam um pipeline próprio para gerar SKILLs (mineração de PRs + objetivo emparelhado), não só um método de avaliação. Se o leres como 'propõe uma abordagem', a Q13 aplica-se (custos e requisitos na pág. 3, 6 e 9). Decide se manténs N/A ou dás Parcial.
